original_claim: The outcome was "Kaplan Meier Estimate of Overall Survival (OS)". Under time frame "From randomization to date of death; median OS follow-up time for censored participants was 77.832 months for nab-Paclitaxel and gemcitabine and 77.799 months for gemcitabine alone"; analysis population "The intent-to-treat population consisted of all randomized participants regardless of whether the participant received any IP or had any efficacy assessment collected."; category "75th Quartile"; denominator "Participants: 434", group "Gemcitabine" had a reported median of 83.0 months.
